blocks.text: Singer-songwriter Jeremy G addressed online backlash after calling himself a “Grammy-nominated songwriter and producer” following BINI’s historic nomination at the 69th Annual Grammy Awards. Jeremy, whose real name is Jeremy Glinoga, co-wrote and co-produced the P-pop girl group’s hit single “Unang Kilig”. The track recently earned a spot in the newly introduced Best Asian Pop […]...
